data.title: In Cambodia's 'Waiting Village', tattooist mourns trade lost to war
data.description: RONG CHAM — More than 3,000 houses stand in neat rows across Rong Cham, a 400-hectare (990-acre) resettlement site dubbed by residents "the Waiting Village", where families who fled fighting along the Cambodia-Thailand border still wait to return home nine months after the ceasefire.

data.title: Bhumjaithai calls to speed up charter rewrite
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Nikorn Chamnong has urged opposition parties to quickly submit their proposed constitutional amendments to parliament, warning that the process of drafting a new charter could take so long that it may not be completed before the next general election.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang, Nong-O join November flyweight Muay Thai grand prix
data.description: Thai stars Rodtang Jitmuangnon and Nong-O Hama will join Russian champion Asadula Imangazaliev in an eight-man ONE Championship flyweight Muay Thai world grand prix due to begin in November.

data.title: Dam in northeastern Thailand faces threat from invasive fish
data.description: Fisheries officials are stepping up their surveillance of invasive blackchin tilapia at Lam Pao Dam in Kalasin after finding 111 fish over the past three weeks, including 12 egg-bearing females.

data.title: Football coach axed for telling female ref 'It's a man's game'
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Columbus Crew sacked Argentine reserve team coach Federico Higuain for telling a female referee "Don't forget this is a man's game" while refusing to release her from a handshake, the Major League Soccer (MLS) club said Tuesday.

data.title: World Cup 'not enough' as Spain begin next chapter
data.description: MADRID - Spain coach Luis de la Fuente will not allow the World Cup winners to rest on their laurels as they get back into action this week for the first time since their triumph.

data.title: 'New one' Klopp promises fresh approach as Germany reign begins
data.description: BERLIN - Germany coach Jurgen Klopp has promised to bring a "new approach" to the country's flagging fortunes, as the four-time world champions begin their latest tilt at a maiden Nations League title.

data.title: Condo sales rebound as low-rise housing stock takes 67 months to clear
data.description: Condo sales in Bangkok and five surrounding provinces rose 19.5% in Q2 2026, while low-rise housing inventory could take 67 months to clear.

data.title: AI political ads warp reality ahead of US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A political ad depicts a US Senate hopeful remarking on God and gender while scrawling in a Bible with a crayon. But he never filmed the clip: it is yet another AI-generated video pushed by a rival ahead of the midterm elections.

data.title: Chile's Atacama Desert blossoms with life after El Nino rains
data.description: CHILE - A resplendent display of flowers has bloomed across Chile's Atacama Desert, one of the driest places on earth, after the El Nino climate phenomenon brought heavy rain to the region.

data.title: French prosecutors probe secret filming of women with smart glasses
data.description: PARIS — Paris prosecutors said they have opened several probes after receiving complaints concerning women filmed on the street without their consent using smart glasses.

data.title: Australia PM says draft social media rules about taking back control
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese defended new draft social media regulations after Washington warned the draft legislation could lead to censorship.

data.title: Hudson, Taylor reunite to help Thai team
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson has announced the addition of Peter Taylor to the coaching staff to help the team in training and enhance the players' potential, specifically regarding physical conditioning.

data.title: The day I met The Squire in Florida
data.description: In this week's 'Paths Crossed', I remember when I was walking down a path towards the first tee of a tournament in Florida and I passed an elderly man wearing a hat. Something made me stop and turn around and I instantly recognised Gene Sarazen, one of the world's top players in the 1920s and 1930s, and the winner of seven major championships.

data.title: Thanongsak back in Japan to defend title
data.description: Thailand's lone world boxing champion Thanongsak Simsri returns to Japan on Saturday when he puts his IBF light flyweight title on the line against Filipino challenger Mark Vicelles at Fujisan Messe.

data.title: Cheating in state exams to become criminal offence
data.description: The government is fast-tracking legislation to make cheating in public-sector recruitment exams a criminal offence and blacklist offenders from working for any state agency.

data.title: Thailand outlines UN peace goals
data.description: Thailand will focus on peace, human rights and regional cooperation at the 81st UN General Assembly (UNGA81) while closely monitoring Cambodian-related issues, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said yesterday.

data.title: Nan gets nod for new university
data.description: The cabinet yesterday approved a bill to establish Nan University, turning the Nan campus of Rajamangala University of Technology Lanna into an autonomous public university focused on innovation and the province's needs.

data.title: Cabinet endorses strategic plan to combat fuel crisis
data.description: The cabinet yesterday endorsed a strategic plan for the Oil Fuel Fund and a fuel crisis response plan covering 2026-2029 with wider use of biofuels made from domestic raw materials to help cope with volatility in global energy markets.

data.title: US human rights lawyer and former White House counsel back Yim Leak
data.description: International human rights lawyer Jared Genser and Lanny J Davis, a former White House special counsel and adviser to former US presidents Bill Clinton and George W Bush, have joined the legal and advocacy team supporting Cambodian businessman Yim Leak, according to Seiden Law LLP, which serves as Mr Yim's chief global counsel.
